title: Reading Drill — Estimating the age of painted boards — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Estimating the age of painted boards — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The paint conservator in Hillswick received an old report about later paint coats looking older than earlier repairs. The report compared the number of distinct paint layers, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the detailed photographs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include exposure to direct light. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed comparison of protected edges as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
